model.mtp_weight.note: Unset by lead; inactive while MTP is off. Required before enabling MTP.

model.head_mode.note: Baseline fixed to projected_ke2_tied; precise KE formulation awaits agreement. Untied is accepted only as an explicit EXP-5 T2 exception.

model.moe.bias_gamma.note: dynamic bias controller not implemented; nonzero fails

optim.lr.note: Baseline 0.001 is timing-only; EXP-1 owns its rates; EXP-2 waits for screening/winner.

model.moe.bias.note: Current runtime accepts explicit bias-free experts only; true must not be advertised as supported.

model.tie_embeddings.owner: Instructor-fixed baseline; G5/G4 confirm mathematical tying contract
model.tie_embeddings.note: Requirement is not an open on/off decision; head mode and tie flag must agree.
